description: The macOS menu-bar popover webview (B1b): it may call our app commands (list_sheds / ui_report / updater_status / updater_check / resize_popover + open_dashboard / open_preferences / app_exit) and listen for Rust-emitted events (refresh / popover-refresh). App-defined commands need no extra ACL; only core + event access is granted, scoped to the `popover` window (least privilege — it does NOT share `main`'s capability).
